title: Peyton's string band and where it played
summary: Peyton was older than Bolden and led a string band with fiddle, trombone and accordion, playing at the 25s near Custom House and Franklin.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Oh, I see. Was Peyton before Bolden? Did Peyton have a band before Bolden? Oh, yeah. He was an older man?
Older man than Buddy Bowling. Well, Bolden was a young man like I was at that time. I don't believe Buddy was quite as old as me, but he was only about a couple of years younger.
How big a band did Peyton have? Do you remember how many in his band?
Well, something like string band. String band. Mm. Carnage player played fiddle, trombone, and accordion.
You know, where did he play? Do you remember any of the dances that he gave? Did you ever go to any of his dances?
Well, I tell you, he used to play at Custom House and Franklin. All night holidays, you know.
Yeah, the entertainers and George Fierclawes.

Before Buddy Bowen started out good. Yeah. And, uh, Peyton played 25. Sometimes he played in, uh, what you call it? Big Angle. Uh huh. And then another place was, uh, and they used to play Little 25. Little, Little 25 were parties from, in Frank. These 25 were, Custom House and Franklin. Uh huh.
Did they always have music at the Little 25 too?
Oh, they had, they had music, but I couldn't call the name of the band.
But none of all of them music was just...
